svg.title: Viticulturist — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as viticulturist, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: Six separate grapes taper into a bunch beneath a short vine stem and small leaf. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
